text.en: Translation opens the doors to other languages and to the world.

This prose lesson by Manavai Mustafa explains that translation is essential for a language to grow and for connecting with the world. The Chinnamanur copper plates show that translation was done in Tamil even in Sangam times, and works were translated from Sanskrit and other languages.
Translation brings knowledge from other languages into Tamil and carries Tamil to the world. It is also a field of education and employment.
Terms: மொழிபெயர்ப்பு (translation), செப்பேடு (copper plate), மொழிவளம் (richness of a language) and கல்வி.
